recognize_zh: 六張高倍圖中的異常早幼粒細胞（promyelocytes）細胞質內充滿粗大、大小不一的深紫紅色顆粒，部分融合成大型包涵體，類似 Chediak-Higashi 顆粒（pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules）；核為卵圓至凹折形，配合 DIC 臨床，指向 APL。
features: Large cells with oval to indented or bilobed (panel E) nuclei and moderately fine chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules of varying size
Giant, round, dark purple-red cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Chediak-Higashi granules (panels B, D, E)
Some cells with a clear perinuclear zone and grey-blue cytoplasmic periphery
Auer rods are not clearly seen in these panels
describe_en: High-power views of peripheral blood show abnormal promyelocytes with oval, indented or bilobed nuclei and abundant cytoplasm containing dense azurophilic granulation. Many cells contain large, round, coarse purple-red granules and inclusions resembling those of Chediak-Higashi syndrome (pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules). Auer rod bundles are not evident in the panels shown. In the setting of disseminated intravascular coagulation, findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules; urgent PML::RARA confirmation by FISH or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Inherited Chediak-Higashi syndrome shows giant granules in otherwise normally maturing neutrophils and lymphocytes in a child with albinism, not in a population of leukemic promyelocytes.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation (non-APL) with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules
ddx.vs: These AMLs have blasts with less abundant granulation and lack PML::RARA, so genetic testing is the discriminator.
G-CSF effect shows orderly maturation with a Golgi hof and normal nuclear shape, and coagulation studies and PML::RARA are negative.
Toxic granules are fine and uniform in mature neutrophils rather than giant inclusions in immature cells.
